Quick status update — attached are the initial artifacts we can share as redacted copies:
- SOC2-AOC-2024.pdf (redacted AOC, excludes customer names and a few control-level details)
- IR_Playbook_v2.docx (high-level runbook excerpt, classification and notification steps included)
- BCP-DR-Summary.xlsx (RTO/RPO targets for hosted services; see notes column for Dedicated/private caveats)

Short answers to Alex's questions:
- Encryption-at-rest: yes, AES-256 by default; for private deployments we support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integrations.
- Notification windows: our standard SLA is to notify customers within 72 hours of confirming a data exposure affecting customer data; regulator notification timelines depend on jurisdiction and severity — we'll provide templated windows per region.

I've also started filling the vendor questionnaire (first pass) — see tab 'RDW_answers'. We should review legal redlines before sending.
